title: EPFO office directory
issuer: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
provision: Head Office, zonal and field-office directory
excerpt: The recently indexed official directory lists EPFO Head Office, zonal offices and their service addresses.
notes: Structural discovery only. Direct retrieval returned 404 on the evidence date, and the directory does not by itself establish the CPIO and FAA designations for each record-owning office.

technical.notes: Indexed official directory coverage and direct-retrieval failure checked. No contact details or incumbent names were copied into project data.

legalRti.notes: Record custody and designation mapping require review.
